positions.title: Bachelor Thesis
positions.description:
Developed a landing spot detection algorithm for MAVs to land in unstructured terrain. 
DLR is developing drones for extraterrestrial exploration, due to the long communication latency they need to operate autonomously.
As bachelor's thesis I developed an algorithm to find safe landing spots in unstructured terrain to use as emergency landing spots during mission failures. Developed in C++ using ROS, OpenCV and Eigen, tested with data from the laboratory and Mt. Etna.

positions.title: Research Intern
positions.description:
- Made an internship at the School of Engineering Sciences and Technology in the field of nanomaterials
- Synthesized graphene from graphite oxide (GO) using a chemical method and verified number of atom layers (ca. 20) using Field Emission Scanning Electron Microscopy and x-ray diffraction.
- Prepared graphene/polyvinyl alcohol (G/PVA) composite materials with various concentrations of graphene to improve the electromagnetic interference shielding capabilities of polyvinyl alcohol.
- Concluded that with 10% graphene in the G/PVA composite, the shielding effectiveness is best as only 4% of 8.2GHz waves (X-band) pass the material, compared to 90% with plain PVA.
